issue.title: Fix dirty tracking for array associations

repository.name: cakephp
repository.description: CakePHP: The Rapid Development Framework for PHP - Official Repository

issue.body:
1:N association properties should be marked as dirty when they are marshalled, and the resulting list has the same number of elements that it did before. Because we can't easily look inside lists, we'll always treat them as dirty. This is the same behavior that existed prior to #9215 for associations.

Improve test coverage around dirty tracking and associations to help catch future regressions around this behavior.

Refs #9267

  ### What you did
  
  If I create form fields like this:

```
    <?= $this->Form->hidden('questions.0.id'); ?>
    <?= $this->Form->input('questions.0.question'); ?>
    <?= $this->Form->hidden('questions.1.id'); ?>
    <?= $this->Form->input('questions.1.question'); ?>
```

**associated data will be saved (updated).**

**EDIT:**
only 3 associated records can be updated!

But, we have an **unknown number of associated fields**, and we create them in this way:

```
<?php
foreach($job->questions as  $key => $value) { ?>
    <?= $this->Form->hidden(sprintf('questions.%s.id', $key)); ?>
    <?= $this->Form->input(sprintf('questions.%s.question', $key)); ?>

<?php } ?>
```

In both examples html fields are identical. for some reason we can not save changes if the field is created with a loop.

What to do?
